mapper.update: update sys_sequence set curvalue = curvalue + 1 where tblname = #{tblname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select curvalue from sys_sequence where tblname = #{tblname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update tl_admin.sys_sequence set curvalue = curvalue + 1 where tblname = #{tblname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select curvalue from tl_admin.sys_sequence where tblname = #{tblname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_dtbsj (id, tblx_dm, mainid, cjsj, tqbz, tqsj, tbcs, sbyy, yxj) values (SEQ_TB_DTBSJ_ID.nextval, #{tblxDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mainid,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{cjsj,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{tqbz,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tqsj,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{tbcs,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sbyy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{yxj,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: select b.swjg_mc,b.swjg_dm,b.swjg_jc,a.jsmode_set as jsms,a.zgswry_dm_set as zgyDm, a.flgl_set as flgldj,a.zsjg_dm_set as zsswjgDm from sys_cfg_czry_fpgl a ,dm_swjg b where a.swjg_dm=b.swjg_dm and b.qybz='Y' and a.czry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select count(1) as num,b.dcode as sbywDm,b.dname as sbywMc from sb_sbxx_hz a,sys_dict b where a.qybj='Y' and a.sbywb_dm=b.dcode and a.sbzl_dm=#{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by b.dcode,b.dname order by b.dcode
select count(1) as num,b.dcode as ywzlDm,b.dname as ywzlMc from sb_sbxx_hz a,sys_dict b where a.sbzl_dm=b.dcode and a.qybj='Y' and b.dtype='ywzl_dm' group by b.dcode,b.dname
select s.* from table(func_get_sblist_sort(#{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sbywDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderSql,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{offset}, #{size},#{type})) s
select s.* from table(func_get_sbhzxx(#{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) s

select tt.* from ( select row_number() OVER(partition by sh.id order by dk.id desc) as RNN, dj.nsrsbh,dj.qyhgdm,dj.nsrmc,dj.swjg_dm as swjgDm,ds.swjg_mc as swjgMc,coalesce(dk.kzxx,'C') as flglcd,dj.tsjsfs_dm as tsjsfsDm, sh.id as sbid,sh.sbywb_dm as sbywbDm,sh.sssq,sh.sbpc,sh.sbzt_dm as sbztDm,sh.sbrq,sh.sbzl_dm as sbzlDm from sb_sbxx_hz sh left join gs_dj_cktmsdab dj on (sh.nsrdzdah=dj.nsrdzdah) left join gs_dj_cktmsdab_kz dk on (dj.nsrdzdah=dk.nsrdzdah and dk.kzlx='FLGLCD' and sh.sbrq between dk.st_date and dk.end_date) left join dm_swjg ds on (ds.swjg_dm=dj.swjg_dm and ds.tsjg_bz='1'), sys_cfg_sbdr_filemode sc where SH."ID"=#{sbid} ) tt where 1>=RNN

select sd.dname as sbywbmc,dj.nsrsbh,(case when sh.sbywb_dm='A0101001' then dj.nsrsbh else dj.qyhgdm end) as qyhgdm,dj.nsrmc,dj.swjg_dm as swjgDm,dj.bsy1_mc as lxr,dj.bsy1_dh as lxrdh, (case coalesce(dk.kzxx,'C') when 'A' then '一' when 'B' then '二' when 'C' then '三' when 'D' then '四' else '' end) as flglcd, dj.tsjsfs_dm as tsjsfsDm, dj.jdxzmc,(case dk2.kzxx when '1' then '是' when ' ' then '是' else '否' end) as wzhqy, sh.id as sbid,sh.sbywb_dm as sbywbDm,sh.sssq as sssq,sh.sbpc as sbpc, sh.sbcs,sh.sbzt_dm as sbztDm,sh.sbrq,sh.sbzl_dm as sbzlDm,sh.zzsbb as zzsbb, substr(ds.swjg_dm,8,4)||' '||ds.swjg_jc as zsswjgMc, ds2.swjg_jc as swjgMc,dj.tag from sb_sbxx_hz sh left join gs_dj_cktmsdab dj on (sh.nsrdzdah=dj.nsrdzdah) left join gs_dj_cktmsdab_kz dk on (dj.nsrdzdah=dk.nsrdzdah and dk.kzlx='FLGLCD' and sh.sbrq between dk.st_date and dk.end_date and dk.flag='1') left join gs_dj_cktmsdab_kz dk2 on (dj.nsrdzdah=dk2.nsrdzdah and dk2.kzlx='WZHQY' and sh.sbrq between dk2.st_date and dk2.end_date and dk.flag='1') left join sys_dict sd on (sh.sbywb_dm=sd.dcode and sd.dtype='ywlx_dm') left join dm_swjg ds on (ds.swjg_dm=dj.zs_swjg_dm) left join dm_swjg ds2 on (ds2.swjg_dm=dj.swjg_dm and ds2.tsjg_bz='1') where SH."ID"=#{sbid} and rownum=1
mapper.update: UPDATE gs_dj_cktmsdab set jdxzmc=#{jdxzmc} WHERE nsrsbh=#{nsrsbh}
mapper.select: select sum(pt.mylaj) as mylaj, sum(pt.rmblaj) as rmblaj, sum(pt.mdtse) as mdtseHw, sum(pt.mdtsbdmzhdkse) as ztsceHw from hx_ckts.ckts_sb_mdt_tssb_gcb pt left join hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 h on h.djxh = pt.djxh and h.ckbgdh = pt.ckbgdh

select nvl(sum(case when RN = 1 then mylaj else 0 end),0) as mylaj, nvl(sum(jsje),0) as jsje, nvl(sum(tse),0) as tse from (select pt.mylaj, jh.jsje, jh.tse, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT.GLH ORDER BY JH.SBXH) RN from hx_ckts.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSSB_GCB pt inner join hx_ckts.CKTS_SB_MTS_TSJH_GCB jh on (pt.lcslid = jh.lcslid and pt.glh = jh.glh) left join hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 h on h.djxh = pt.djxh and h.ckbgdh = pt.ckbgdh
)

select nvl(sum(pt.mylaj),0) as mylaj, nvl(sum(pt.jsje),0) as jsje, nvl(sum(pt.tse),0) as tse from hx_ckts.CKTS_SB_DB_TSSB_GCB pt left join hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 h on h.djxh = pt.djxh and h.ckbgdh = pt.ckbgdh
select nvl(sum(pt.jsje),0) as jsje, nvl(sum(pt.se),0) as se, nvl(sum(pt.tse),0) as tse from hx_ckts.CKTS_SB_GJ_SBMX_GCB pt
select count(1) from tl_admin.sys_user_role pt,tl_admin.sys_user u where pt.czyid = u.id and u.czry_dm = #{czryDm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pt.rolecode = 'DZBACZ'

select count(*) from tl_admin.edoc_examine_business pt where pt.swjgdm like #{swjgdm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%' and (pt.releaser = #{releaser,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
and pt.status != '4'
and nvl(pt.void_flag,'0') = '0'

select dj.bsy1_mc as lxr, dj.bsy1_dh as lxrdh, substr(ds.swjg_dm, 8, 4) || ' ' || ds.swjg_jc as zsswjgMc, ds2.swjg_jc as swjgMc, dj.tag from tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab dj left join tl_bjts.dm_swjg ds on (ds.swjg_dm = dj.zs_swjg_dm) left join tl_bjts.dm_swjg ds2 on (ds2.swjg_dm = dj.swjg_dm and ds2.tsjg_bz = '1') where dj.nsrsbh = #{nsrsbh}
select qygzxx from TL_TSSH.glxt_bb_shxt_djxx where djxh_js=#{djxh}
